SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name, ts.account_type, ts.isa_type
FROM product p
INNER JOIN tax_saving ts ON p.id = ts.id
WHERE p.product_type = 'TAX_SAVING'
ORDER BY p.id

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name, ts.account_type, ts.isa_type
FROM product p
INNER JOIN tax_saving ts ON p.id = ts.id
WHERE p.product_type = 'TAX_SAVING' AND ts.account_type = #{accountType}
ORDER BY p.id

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name, ts.account_type, ts.isa_type
FROM product p
INNER JOIN tax_saving ts ON p.id = ts.id
WHERE p.product_type = 'TAX_SAVING' AND ts.account_type = 'ISA' AND ts.isa_type = #{isaType}
ORDER BY p.id

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name, ts.account_type, ts.isa_type
FROM product p
INNER JOIN tax_saving ts ON p.id = ts.id
WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND p.product_type = 'TAX_SAVING'
